job.job_description:
About the Role

We are looking for a passionate Backend Developer with 1-3 years of experience who enjoys building scalable, reliable, and high-performance backend systems. The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of software architecture, API development, and cloud-native applications, while effectively using AI-powered development and testing tools to improve productivity and code quality.

You will work closely with product managers, frontend developers, QA engineers, and DevOps teams to design and build robust backend services that power enterprise SaaS applications.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications and RESTful APIs.
Build secure, high-performance, and maintainable services using modern backend frameworks.
Understand business requirements and translate them into efficient technical solutions.
Participate in system design discussions and contribute to architecture decisions.
Write clean, reusable, and well-documented code following engineering best practices.
Use AI-assisted development tools (such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude, or similar) to accelerate development, debugging, documentation, and testing.
Develop comprehensive unit, integration, and API tests with the help of AI-assisted testing tools where appropriate.
Optimize application performance, database queries, and system reliability.
Troubleshoot production issues and implement long-term fixes.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
Participate in code reviews and continuously improve engineering standards.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
13 years of experience in backend software development.
Strong programming skills in at least one backend language such as Python, Java, Node.js, or Go.
Experience building RESTful APIs and microservices.
Good understanding of software design principles, object-oriented programming, and design patterns.
Strong knowledge of system architecture, distributed systems concepts, and scalable application design.
Experience working with relational and/or NoSQL databases.
Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows.
Understanding of authentication, authorization, and API security.
Experience using AI tools to improve software development, code generation, testing, debugging, and documentation.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Preferred Skills

Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized deployments.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
Experience with asynchronous processing, messaging systems, or event-driven architectures.
Knowledge of caching technologies such as Redis.
Exposure to observability tools including logging, monitoring, and tracing.

What We're Looking For

Strong system-thinking and architectural mindset.
Curiosity to learn emerging technologies and AI-driven engineering practices.
Ability to quickly understand complex systems and propose scalable solutions.
Ownership, accountability, and attention to quality.
Team player with excellent collaboration and communication skills.
Passion for building enterprise-grade software that delivers exceptional customer experiences.
